classification.question_topic: Why the dream ends before the dreamer gets to eat the food / feels not 'allowed' to eat dream foods

meta.author_theory: The place seems to be run by employees that feel like potentially other dreamers (not just background people). Felt almost like I got woken up like I wasn't "allowed" to eat the dream foods.

position.relative_to: common food place in my mallworld

qualities.raw_description: Common food place in my mallworld; almost always really busy; "people were practically jumping over each other for food"; strong smell of food; feels like an irl contemporary fast food/pick up type place, not a retro restaurant; dream usually ends before I get to try the food; employees/staff "super chill"

interactions.description: Dreamer "ordered" a large amount of food at Mel's Tiki Bar while it was extremely busy; staff were chill about it.

entities_involved.description: employees/staff running the place; "super chill"; felt like potentially other dreamers (not just background people)
people "practically jumping over each other for food"

interactions.transaction_item: a whole pizza; three boxes of buttered shrimp and orange chicken; a whole chocolate cake; 2 plates of strawberry sherbet

interactions.description: Dreamer finally found a seat after ordering.
After sitting, dreamer was "getting stared down by large families of other people still waiting to be served".

entities_involved.description: large families staring down the dreamer while waiting to be served

interactions.description: Dream usually ends/wake-up occurs before dreamer gets to try the food; closest remembered was trying some sort of smoothie; felt like getting woken up as if not "allowed" to eat the dream foods.
interactions.transaction_item: some sort of smoothie (closest the dreamer remembers managing to try)
interactions.transaction_blocker: Dream ends / wake-up before eating; described as feeling like not "allowed"

extraction.extraction_notes: Only one explicit location is described (Mel's Tiki Bar) as a recurring food place within the broader 'mallworld'. No explicit routes/connections or physical layout details beyond seating and crowd behavior.
